subject: Ledger rollback and withdrawal credit guidance
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@brightwood.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: trellis-ops@brightwood.com
Date: 2027-07-22T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected June ingestion billing spike — request to rollback

Hi Mina,

We pulled our June invoice and saw a large spike that matches a migration window on 2027-06-14. The attached invoice and the ingest_spike_analysis.csv show what appears to be duplicate batch ingests (two jobs wrote the same data). The result is an overcharge of ~13,720 token units (see tab "dup-check").

Can Redwood do a ledger rollback for the duplicate tokens and apply either a credit memo or refund to our account? For accounting, we need: (1) a written credit note we can book in July, and (2) a clear indication whether the credit includes any sales tax or VAT implications.

We prefer a credit memo applied to our next invoice, but if you require a refund route let us know. Timebox: our month-end close is 2027-07-31, so any paperwork before then is ideal.

Attaching: BRIGHTWOOD_Invoice_202706.pdf and ingest_spike_analysis.csv.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Park
Senior Ops Manager
Brightwood Systems

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-22T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected June ingestion billing spike — request to rollback

Elena — thanks for the clear packet and the CSV. I copied Laura (Finance) and Rishi (Billing ops) so we can move this quickly.

Initial steps from our side:
- I will open a formal billing investigation (ticket #RB-2027-8794) and tag it high-priority.
- Rishi will pull the raw usage logs for the June 14 migration window and validate the duplicate ingest pattern.
- Laura will draft a provisional credit memo for the overbilled amount; we can apply it against your next invoice pending final verification.

Provisional plan: if the verification confirms duplicate ingestion, Redwood will issue a ledger rollback for the identified duplicate token units and post a credit memo for the net USD amount. For the tax note — we will follow Redwood's credit-note practice (credit excludes sales tax; VAT handling depends on your VAT ID and country). Please confirm whether Brightwood needs the credit issued with a reverse-charge or VAT-inclusive document and share your VAT ID if applicable.

Next steps for you: please confirm payment method preference (credit against future invoice vs ACH refund) and, if applicable, your VAT ID and billing contact. We aim to have a provisional credit memo to you within 48 business hours.

I will follow up once the ticket is created and attach logs.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-22T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ledger rollback and withdrawal credit guidance

Hi Elena / Mina —

We completed a preliminary reconciliation with Rishi's logs. Summary below (provisional, subject to final audit):
- Identified duplicate ingest batches on 2027-06-14 resulting in 13,720 duplicate token units.
- Unit charge used for June invoice: $0.00275 per token unit.
- Gross overcharge: $37.73 (13,720 * 0.00275) -> rounded to $37.73 on invoice lines.

Credit treatment:
- We will issue a credit memo for $37.73 and apply it to Brightwood's next invoice. If you prefer an ACH refund instead, we can process that after the final audit; refunds take ~7 business days to clear.

Tax/VAT note:
- Because Brightwood's billing address is currently on file as: 1220 Harbor Ave, Seattle, WA, US, Redwood will issue the credit memo excluding US sales tax (our invoices for US addresses do not include sales tax).
- If Brightwood is registered for VAT in an EU country and requires the credit note to carry VAT information, please provide the EU VAT ID and the company billing address for proper VAT handling and reverse-charge notation.

Requested confirmations:
1) Confirm you want the credit applied to next invoice (default) or an ACH refund.
2) Confirm the billing/legal name and VAT ID if VAT handling is required.

I have prepared a provisional_credit_memo.pdf (attached) that mirrors the numbers above. Once you confirm, I will finalize and post the ledger rollback and mark the ticket closed.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
Finance | accounting@redwood.com

From: Elena Park <elena.park@brightwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-23T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ledger rollback and withdrawal credit guidance

Thanks — appreciate the quick work. Confirming:
- Brightwood accepts the $37.73 credit memo applied to next invoice.
- Billing/legal name: Brightwood Systems, Inc.
- VAT: Brightwood is US-based and does not have an EU VAT ID for this entity.
- Please mark the credit memo "non-taxable adjustment" for our records.

Can you confirm the credit will appear on our 2027-08 invoice so our accounting team can close their July books? If you can post the ledger rollback by 2027-07-28 that would be ideal.

If you need anything else, let me know — otherwise we'll wait for the finalized memo.

Best,
Elena Park
Senior Ops Manager
Brightwood Systems
